title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
slides: What if trillion-parameter AI left the cloud?
Mistral released weights for a million-token model
Weights are open, but training data stays hidden
Security teams can now audit model internals directly
Download it; test it against your own threats this week
thread_text:
1. Trillion-Parameter AI Leaves Cloud

Mistral just released weights for a million-token model. That means massive AI can now run on your own hardware, no cloud required.

2. Weights Open, Data Hidden

The model weights are publicly available, but the training data remains proprietary. You get full access to the internals, but not the source material.

3. Audit Model Internals Directly

Security teams can now inspect the model's inner workings without relying on third-party APIs. This enables direct vulnerability testing and custom threat analysis.

4. Test Against Your Own Threats

Download the model and run it against your specific security scenarios. No more generic benchmarks—real-world validation on your terms.

5. Download and Test This Week

Grab the weights from Mistral's repository and start testing. What threats will you uncover first?
